+from rich.highlighter import ReprHighlighter
+from rich.text import Text
+
+def test_url_with_tilde():
+    highlighter = ReprHighlighter()
+    url = "https://example.com/~user"
+    text = Text(url)
+    highlighter.highlight(text)
+    
+    # The URL should be highlighted as a single span
+    # In ReprHighlighter, URLs are highlighted with the style "repr.url"
+    # Let's check if the entire URL is highlighted.
+    
+    # Find the span that matches the URL
+    url_span = next((span for span in text.spans if span.style == "repr.url"), None)
+    
+    if url_span is None:
+        print("No URL span found")
+        assert False
+    
+    print(f"URL span: {url_span}")
+    assert url_span.start == 0
+    assert url_span.end == len(url)
+    print("Success!")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_url_with_tilde()
